capabilities.body: OpenAmer otayi longekidha oshilonga, tayi shi longo niilongitho yenene — oshihokololi shomalombwelo, omutali gwointaneta, omafaela, okoodi — nokuhupitha shoka sha longo nawa.
capabilities.title: Omuyakuli ta dhiladhila pamwe nangoye

capabilities.body: Omapopyo, edhimbuluko noonkalantumwa dhounongo otadhi kala mokompiuta ndjika. Kapuna shoka tashi tumwa pombanda ngele ino shi pula.
capabilities.title: Iikwatelwa yoye, uuyelele woye

capabilities.body: Omalaka 186, kehe limwe moshinyolwa shoka ho lesha. Epandja lyotango lyopolohalama otali ku pula hogolole limwe.
capabilities.title: Elaka lyoye, mondjila

capabilities.body: Uunongo otawu hupithwa miilonga yene, opo iilonga yokehe esiku yi kale ya pumbwa ethimbo eshona sho to yi longitha.
capabilities.title: Uunongo tawu koko

help: Tala ngele okompiuta ndjika otayi vulu okuya kointaneta.
Alulula elongekidho — oonkatu ndhoka dha pwa itadhi alululwa.
Ngele sha nyono luvali, egulula omakonakono; omikweyo dha hugunina otadhi holola onkatu.
failure.lead: Kapuna omalundululo ga alululwa ko inaashi tseyithwa — OpenAmer otayi thikama mpoka ya thikama, opo elongekidho etiyali li tsikilepo mpoka.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer otayi tsikile nokulongitha oshipewa shoshito nokulonga. Kapuna shoka sha pingathanwa oshindambo.
failure.title: Elongekidho inali pwa

language.lead: Elongekidho otali tsikile melaka ndyoka to hogolola mpaka. Oto vulu oku li lundulula konima mopolohalama.
language.title: Hogolola elaka lyoye

progress.lead: Elongekidho lyolumwe: OpenAmer otayi hulu shoka ya pumbwa nokulongekidha okompiuta ndjika. Ngele tayi tamekwa konima, inayi pumbwa okuninga ishi natango.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer otayi pingathana oshipewa shoshito. Iikala yoye, edhimbuluko nomalongekidho otayi kala inaayi lundululwa.
progress.title: Ta longekidha OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Ta ndhindhilike kutya okutula kwa pwa
stages.configure: Ta longekidha iishapi ya API noonkalantumwa dhounongo
stages.venv: Ta shiti onkalo yokulongela ya Python

cards.body: Egulula opolohalama nokuhokolola shoka wa hala shi ningwe. OpenAmer otayi longo pombunda nokukugalulila epopiyo.
cards.title: Tameka nefatululo limwe

cards.body: Omalongekidho → Eulikilo → Elaka. Oonkalo dhomalaka 186, dhi na okulundululwa ethimbo kehe.
cards.title: Hogolola elaka lyoye

cards.body: Iilonga tayi endululwa otayi ningi uunongo — ethimbo lya landula otayi pumbwa elombwelo limwe ashike.
cards.title: Yi pitika yi dhimbulukwe

success.lead: Kehe shimwe sha longekidhwa. OpenAmer ngashingeyi oyoye — mokompiuta ndjika, melaka lyoye.
success.title: OpenAmer ya longekidhwa

bullets: Otayi longo mokompiuta yoye — omapopyo goye otaga kala mokompiuta ndjika

welcome.lead: Omuyakuli gwoye mwene. Miikwatelwa yoye. Melaka lyoye.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer oshipewa shipe ya longekidhwa. Otashi pingathana oshipewa shoshito nokuhupitha iikala nomalongekidho agehe.
welcome.note: Otashi pula oominute oshona pethimbo lyekwatathano lyointaneta lya yela.
welcome.title: Tu ku tambula mu OpenAmer
